scientific_boundary: Evidence map; five non-exchangeable programme families, not five replicates of architecture evolution. Architecture-origin causation, matched historical states, K(u), and common effect estimands remain unidentified. Despres mutation pairs and crossing events are selected assay observations, not independent biological transitions. Mihajlovic figures 2/3 were SHA-pinned from the publisher, with two non-poolable replicate-line effects audited; no absolute cross-study effect.
